method: 120-digit Decimal positive quadratic root locates the neighborhood; adjacent binary64 quantities are evaluated with a separate exact rational monomial sum using the represented coefficient 0.05. References labeled OverflowError mean exact complete result cannot round to finite binary64. Current returned infinity is recorded, not accepted as a pass; a one-ulp finite difference needs an explicit accuracy contract.
limits: Exploratory next-batch baseline, not a completed cost contract or independent reviewer sign-off.
